method: Read-only source and test review; no real database or provider request; no changes to social lot.
no_concrete_security_defect_identified: Owner only from ToolExecutionContext, controlled by engine; no dynamic owner/schema/columns parameters.
Query is owner-filtered and every returned row including pagination sentinel is owner-validated.
Fixed output projection excludes content, tokens and raw provider result/error fields.
Bounded keyset page over canonical UUIDs, strict ordering and duplicate checks, no claim of a snapshot.
Stored association and publication metadata explicitly do not imply current provider health or new publication.
Simulation returns simulated/no evidence and skips database/schema selection.
Registered only for existing maitre-des-publicites, not user-custom tools.
Trace minimization is implemented by existing engine.
Supabase SDK tests inject HTTP transport and check method, schema, owner, cursor and projection; these tests were reviewed, not rerun by this reviewer.

findings.severity: functional gap, blocking end-to-end usage claim
findings.title: Stored social metadata is executed then discarded in the registered agent path
evidence: karta/src/engine/loop.ts: single decide happens before the tool loop; subsequent tool parameters come from that prior decision.
karta/src/engine/loop.ts: tool result goes only to persistPrivateToolResult, assertToolResult and minimized trace; no subsequent model turn or result-to-context handoff.

karta/src/engine/private-tool-results.ts: persistPrivateToolResult allows only knowledge_search and quantum_simulate on custom agents, so social_status on maitre-des-publicites returns not_applicable.
karta/src/tools/social-status.ts sets metadata_only, so trace output does not preserve items or nextAfterId.
findings.impact: The registered tool can read a first page, but neither the model nor the client receives its metadata/cursor through this path. It cannot use that result to plan subsequent page reads or adapt the generated offer.
findings.recommendation: Use an existing authorized private result delivery or a bounded result-to-next-step flow under its own impact analysis and tests; until then qualify this lot as a safe read component with incomplete product consumption. Do not expose raw tool data through telemetry to bypass this gap.

followup.note: The post-decision result-consumption gap was corrected through awaited pre-inference context. Preserve this file as the historical finding.
